test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I caught / a white cat / rustling / beneath my room.
solution:
The correct answer is **“beneath my room.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The segment "beneath my room" implies a location but is grammatically incorrect because it lacks a specific action related to the subject. Typically, prepositions such as "beneath" are followed by a nou
